$2,525.00 / month
Available 9/1/2026
  • 3 Bed

Old fashioned charm can be found here with ceiling fans, a pellet stove, a formal dining room, family room, breakfast nook, and much more. Located in a mature neighborhood with lots of trees providing cool shade. Two story home with 3 ample sized bedrooms and 2 baths upstairs and 1/2 bath and laundry area downstairs. Skylight in upstairs guest bathroom. Master bath has double sinks and very unique walk-in closet. Double garage plus extra parking alongside as well as behind a gate for bigger toys or small RV. Landscaping is ala natural but tenant is responsible for keeping all weeds under total control. Extra large back deck is enclosed with short fence and exit gates on either side. Numerous floor length windows throughout with openings at floor level provides great air circulation. All appliances provided - Electric Range/Double Door Fridge (Ice maker & water dispenser doesn't work) Dishwasher/Microwave/Garbage Disposal. Extra fridge in garage. Hard wood floors in family room, kitchen and breakfast nook. Carpet throughout otherwise. E-Wall heaters as well as the pellet stove for heat. Tenant is responsible for all utilities. NO CATS PLEASE. Owner has suffered too much cat damage previously! Small/Med sized dogs will be considered with rental history. Please do drive-by and/or walk about before turning in application. To Apply: Go to www.hummingbirdpropertymanagement.com, click on apply now, read the criteria thoroughly to determine if you think you could qualify. No application fees are charged until we are ready to process you. All persons over 18 must complete an application. Security Deposit Subject to Change.
